root_cause_criterion.missing_conjunct: before probing the Classes sentinel, the parser must require `dat->byte + 16 <= dat->size` in addition to accepting the section table entry
root_cause_criterion.criterion: At Classes entry, `decode_R13_R2000` may call the 16-byte sentinel `memcmp` only when the cursor stored in `dat->byte` still leaves 16 readable bytes in the input buffer, i.e. `dat->byte + 16 <= dat->size`. The vulnerable original copies the parsed Classes address into `dat->byte` and reaches `memcmp` without enforcing that bound; the fixed source adds this exact guard before the sentinel probe.
root_cause_criterion.description: AddressSanitizer reports a 16-byte heap-buffer-overflow read from `&dat->chain[dat->byte]` in the Classes sentinel `memcmp`. The missing source-level obligation is the Classes-entry bound `dat->byte + 16 <= dat->size` immediately after `dat->byte` is set from the section address at line 1108.

nodes.state: At the Classes sentinel `memcmp`, the 16-byte probe end `dat->byte + 16` still exceeds `dat->size`, so the sink reads past the end of the input buffer.

edges.relation: The parsed Classes section address is copied unchanged into `dat->byte` at Classes entry, becoming the cursor used for the sentinel probe.
The same Classes cursor stored in `dat->byte` becomes the starting offset of the 16-byte sentinel `memcmp` at the sink.
